reason: Observation 2026-11-27: the description « Use for all public web requests » made this 12.8 k-char internals document a mandatory read before every web search (3 of 3 web turns read it, 15 k chars each time, with no change in the calls made afterwards). Its routing section also contradicted walter_browse's single-door contract: it said « use web_search first », but web_search is not a W.Alter tool, and walter_browse(query=…) searches. The « First-class Hermes tool » section (tool_search/tool_describe/tool_call, terminal fallback) is stale: Hermes has been stopped since 10/11. What changes: the description now targets diagnosis of a failed or doubtful walter_browse result; the routing chain is condensed; the output contract, verification rules, CLI, lot references and the merged fallback procedure are kept.
